e1Pins.sharedMetaVocabulary: the six consumed meta types are byte-identical to MIDI_EXPORT_META_TYPES
e1Pins.law: import(export(plan)) preserves the chord content the writer encoded: the pinned E1 golden decodes to the same notes, tempo, meter, and markers the E1 fixture states, and its sonority resolves to the symbol family the marker names

smf.runningStatusLaw: a data byte where a status byte is expected reuses the previous channel status; meta and sysex events cancel running status; a data byte with no running status in effect refuses
smf.velocityZeroLaw: a note-on with velocity zero is a note-off, exactly as MIDI 1.0 defines; the E1 writer never emits this form, so it is a mandatory import-only family
smf.pairingLaw: per (track, channel, key): note-on opens, already-open refuses smf.note_overlap; note-off or velocity-zero note-on closes, not-open refuses smf.note_off_unmatched; end-of-track with open notes refuses smf.note_on_unterminated; off velocity is declared non-retained
smf.conductorLaw: in format 1 files, setTempo and timeSignature metas outside track 0 refuse smf.conductor_meta_misplaced; format 0 has a single conductor-and-voice track
smf.alienChunkLaw: a chunk whose printable four-byte tag is neither MThd nor MTrk is skipped and recorded in the alien-chunk ledger; a non-printable tag refuses smf.chunk_invalid; an extra MTrk beyond the declared count refuses smf.track_count_invalid
smf.duplicateNameLaw: the first trackName and instrumentName meta per track are consumed; later ones are recorded as duplicate-track-name / duplicate-instrument-name ignored events
smf.textDecodingLaw: consumed meta text decodes as UTF-8 with U+FFFD replacement; text bytes are never evaluated, parsed as markup, or turned into URLs

sonorityLaws.windowFormula: windowTicks = floor(40000 * ppq / microsecondsPerQuarterAtAnchor); the tempo in effect at the anchor tick (last tempo entry at or before it, default 500000) governs the whole window; wall-clock time is never measured
sonorityLaws.groupingLaw: notes sort by (onTick, trackIndex, channel, key); a note joins the open sonority exactly when onTick - anchorTick <= windowTicks, else it closes the sonority and anchors a new one; windows are anchored, never chained
sonorityLaws.gridFormula: per meter segment starting at T0 with beatUnit 2^dd: N = (t - T0) * beatUnit, D = ppq, gridIndex = floor((2N + D) / (2D)) with half-cell ties rounding up; quantizedTick = (T0 * beatUnit + gridIndex * ppq) / beatUnit exactly; errorNumerator = |t * beatUnit - quantizedTickNumerator|, errorDenominator = beatUnit
sonorityLaws.measureLaw: meter segments start at tick 0 (default 4/4 when absent) and at each timeSignature tick, which always begins a new measure; a segment of length L contributes ceil(L * beatUnit / (numerator * 4 * ppq)) measures; measureIndex = completed prior-segment measures + floor((quantizedTickNumerator - T0 * beatUnit) / (numerator * 4 * ppq))
sonorityLaws.bassLaw: bassMidi is the lowest MIDI number among sonority members; pitch classes are midi mod 12, sorted ascending, duplicates removed
sonorityLaws.durationLaw: deferred-to-build-phase: chart duration derivation (anchor-to-next-anchor within the measure map) is a jcpe-v3c2.2 decision and no expectation in this packet depends on it

resolutionLaws.candidateRootLaw: candidate roots are exactly the pitch classes present in the sonority; an absent root is never invented
resolutionLaws.matchLaw: for root r the offset set is {(pc - r) mod 12}; a template matches exact when the offset set equals its fingerprint, and omitted-fifth when the template is omissible and the offsets equal the fingerprint minus offset 7
resolutionLaws.customFallbackLaw: zero template matches yield the Custom outcome carrying the literal pitch classes spelled by the canonical table, bass first then ascending wrapping mod 12 - never an invented name
resolutionLaws.symbolRendering: deferred-to-T0-formatter-in-build-phase: alternatives carry T1 formula rule ids and evidence, never symbol strings, so this packet cannot fork the T0 grammar

offsetSemantics.smf.header_invalid: 0 for a tag mismatch, 4 for a bad header length, file length for a file shorter than 14 bytes
offsetSemantics.smf.track_count_invalid: 10 for header-time violations; the extra chunk's tag offset or the file length for count mismatches
offsetSemantics.smf.chunk_truncated: the crossed boundary: min(declared chunk end, file length)
offsetSemantics.smf.delta_invalid: first byte of the offending variable-length quantity
offsetSemantics.smf.event_invalid: the offending status or data byte
offsetSemantics.smf.meta_length_invalid: first byte of the meta length quantity
offsetSemantics.smf.meta_oversized: first byte of the meta length quantity
offsetSemantics.smf.meter_invalid: the offending payload byte (numerator, else denominator power)
offsetSemantics.smf.end_of_track_invalid: the position after the end-of-track event when more data follows, else the declared track end
offsetSemantics.limit.midi_import_events_exceeded: first byte of the event that exceeded the cap
offsetSemantics.limit.midi_import_notes_exceeded: first byte of the note-on that exceeded the cap
offsetSemantics.limit.midi_import_tick_horizon_exceeded: first byte of the delta that pushed past the horizon
offsetSemantics.limit.midi_import_tempo_changes_exceeded: first byte of the tempo meta that exceeded the cap
offsetSemantics.limit.midi_import_meter_changes_exceeded: first byte of the meter meta that exceeded the cap

verifyRegistration: not-registered: adding validate:m0-contract to scripts/verify.ts is the orchestrator's landing decision; the intended slot is the contract-validator band beside validate:e1-contract
